profile.headline: ⭐ Mid-Level Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer (React/Node/TS) | Gameplay Programmer (Unity/C#) | API Integrations & Automation
profile.summary:
I’m a Mid-Level Software Engineer with a hybrid background in full-stack development, automation, and game programming.

On the software side, I’ve built digital marketplaces, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and custom content platforms using React, Node.js, TypeScript, and SQL databases. I enjoy designing admin tools, dashboards, and workflows that automate real business problems.

On the game side, I work with Unity (C#) and early Unreal Engine to prototype gameplay systems, including a match-3 progression game and a 3D fighting prototype with training-stage style arenas and controller support.

I’m comfortable working end-to-end: UI → backend → database → deployment, and I like integrating external APIs, building tools for other developers, and keeping a tight feedback loop with users.

Currently open to:
• Mid-Level Software / Full-Stack Engineering roles (React/Node/TS)
• Gameplay Programmer / Tools roles (Unity/C# or hybrid web + game tools)
• Remote or Raleigh, NC opportunities

positions.title: Software Engineer / Technical Founder
positions.description:
Developing a digital product marketplace with automated pricing, product ingestion, and secure order workflows

Building internal tools including CMS dashboards, role-based access control, and analytics workflows

Integrating third-party APIs from gaming and software vendors (product imports, inventory sync, license fulfillment)

Deploying live services using Vercel and Bolt.new

positions.title: Composite technician
positions.description:
Fabricated, assembled, and repaired aerospace composite materials, ensuring adherence to quality standards and specifications.
Operated advanced equipment such as autoclaves and vacuum bagging systems to prepare and cure composite materials.
Performed inspections and non-destructive testing (NDT) to identify defects and ensure product compliance.
Assessed and repaired damaged composite components using technical manuals and engineering guidelines.
Collaborated with engineers and teams to resolve production issues and implement process improvements.
Maintained tools and workspaces to meet safety and operational standards.
Interpreted engineering drawings and blueprints to fabricate parts accurately and efficiently.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a freelance software developer, I specialize in creating innovative web and desktop applications using modern technologies, including JavaScript, C#, HTML, and CSS. My work involves designing, developing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet client-specific needs.

Key Responsibilities:
Full-Stack Development: Developed responsive and dynamic web applications using JavaScript frameworks, including React.js and Node.js, ensuring seamless user experiences and robust backend support.
Desktop Applications: Built cross-platform desktop applications using C# and .NET frameworks, focusing on performance and reliability.
UI/UX Design: Crafted intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces with HTML and CSS, ensuring accessibility and responsiveness.
Software Integration: Integrated APIs and third-party services to enhance application functionality and streamline workflows.
Version Control: Maintained code repositories using GitHub for project tracking, version control, and collaboration.
Project Management: Delivered custom software solutions on time by following Agile methodologies, managing tasks, and communicating with clients effectively.
Problem Solving & Debugging: Diagnosed and resolved technical issues, optimizing system performance and improving software efficiency.
Notable Projects:
Explore my GitHub portfolio for project showcases, including:

Full-stack web stores selling digital content (game keys for PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam).
Custom engineering and manufacturing tracking tools for businesses.
An AI-driven Math API for educational platforms.
Game development projects focusing on interactive and engaging experiences.
